αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αὐτοῖο: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic αὐτοῦ): ’him’, after πάροιθε ’before him’
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg.: ’of himself, him’ · also the adverb αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένετ: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γένετ’ = γένετο = ἐγένετο)
γέρας: γέρας — prize of honour, privilege, due portion; neut. nom./acc. sg.
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γούνων: γόνυ — knee; neut. gen. pl., epic γούνων (= Attic γονάτων); gen. of the part grasped, after λαβέ
δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear, tears; neut. acc. sg., object of χέω: ’shedding tears’
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δία: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. acc. sg. Δία
δαναοῖσιν: Δαναοί — the Danaans (a name for the Greeks); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
δαναῶν: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. gen. pl.
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἶμι: εἶμι — go, will go; pres. 1 sg. with future sense (= Attic fut. of ἔρχομαι): ’I am going, I will go’
εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
εὐχόμενος: εὔχομαι — pray, vow, boast; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’praying’
ζαθέην: ζάθεος — most holy, very sacred (intensive ζα- + θεός); fem. acc. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
κίλλαν: Κίλλα — Cilla, a town of the Troad with a cult of Apollo; fem. acc. sg.
καθέζετο: καθέζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκαθέζετο)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’
κλισίας: κλισίη — hut, shelter (of soldiers); fem. acc. pl., Ionic (= Attic κλισίας from κλισία)
κλῦθί: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg., + gen.: ’hear me!’
κρήηνον: κραιαίνω (= κραίνω) — accomplish, fulfil; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg.; as accusative of respect, χωόμενος κῆρ ’incensed in heart’
λαὸν: λαός — people, host; masc. acc. sg.
λοιγὸν: λοιγός — ruin, destruction, havoc; masc. acc. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big; masc. acc. sg.
μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg.
μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black, dark; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα, standing epithet of ships
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic (= Attic μου); κλῦθί μευ ’hear me’
μητίετα: μητίετα — counsellor, wise in counsel (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg., epic -α
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νηῒ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. sg., epic νῆα
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)
οὐρανὸν: οὐρανός — heaven, sky; masc. acc. sg.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔλυμπον: Οὔλυμπος (Ὄλυμπος) — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg., goal of motion with the -δε ’to’ that follows
οὔτέ: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj., accented οὔτέ before an enclitic
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάροιθ: πάροιθε(ν) (elided πάροιθ’) — before, in front of; prep. + gen., or adv.
πέρ: περ — at least, even; enclitic restrictive/intensive particle, accented before the enclitic μοι: τιμήν πέρ ’honour at least’
παιδὸς: παῖς — child, son; masc. gen. sg.
παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
πείσεσθαι: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey (+ dat.); fut. inf. mid.: ’to obey, to be going to obey’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’)
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many counsels, very wily, epithet of Odysseus (μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv. · with a negative or ἤν: ’never, if ever’
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε)
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
πρό: πρό — before, beforehand; adv./prep.; also a preverb in tmesis (πρό … εἴπομεν = προείπομεν ’we told beforehand’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’)
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στρατὸν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. acc. sg. · also relative, ’whom, which’; accented before an enclitic
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τενέδοιό: Τένεδος — Tenedos, an island off the Troad; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (accented before an enclitic)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’
τοῖο: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic τοῦ); gen. of the person heard after ἀκούω: ’him’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’with them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg.: ’this’
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg.
φίλῳ: φίλος — dear, beloved, one’s own; adj., masc. dat. sg.
φοῖβος: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (‘bright, radiant’); masc. nom. sg.
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; fem. acc. sg.
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χρύσην: Χρύσης — Chryses, priest of Apollo; masc. acc. sg. · also Χρύση — Chryse, his town in the Troad; fem. acc. sg.
χρύσης: Χρύσης — Chryses, priest of Apollo; masc. nom. sg.
ἀέκοντος: ἀέκων — unwilling (= Attic ἄκων); masc. gen. sg., agreeing with ἐμεῖο: ’against my will’
ἀγέμεν: ἄγω — lead, take; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἄγειν)
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγορὴν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering place; acc. sg. (Ionic for Attic ἀγορά)
ἀεικέα: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. pl.
ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’)
ἀμφιβέβηκας: ἀμφιβαίνω — stand astride, stand over to protect; perf. 2 sg., with present sense
ἀνάσσεις: ἀνάσσω — rule, be lord (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg. · also + dat., ’rule over’ (θεοῖσι καὶ ἀνθρώποισιν ἀνάσσεις)
ἀπούρας: ἀπαυράω — take away from, rob of; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. ἀπούρας (a defective verb)
ἀργείοισι: Ἀργεῖοι — Argives, Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀργυρότοξ: ἀργυρότοξος — silver-bowed, epithet of Apollo; voc. sg., elided (ἀργυρότοξ’ = ἀργυρότοξε)
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοῖσιν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’
ἄγων: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’leading’
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐέλδωρ: ἐέλδωρ — wish, desire; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμεῦ: ἐγώ — I; gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen.
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐόντες: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντες): ’being’
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑκάεργον: ἑκάεργος — far-working, far-shooting (epithet of Apollo); masc. acc. sg.
ἑκατόμβην: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, great sacrifice (originally of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. sg.
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= ἔβη): ’went’
ἔδησαν: δέω — bind, tie; aor. 3 pl. act.
ἔκλυε: κλύω — hear, hearken to, heed; aor. 3 sg. (+ gen. of person heard)
ἔπει: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by word’
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργῳ: ἔργον — deed, action; neut. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by deed’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἠτίμησεν: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (ἠτίμησε(ν))
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἥμενον: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’sitting’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα
ἧσθαι: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. inf.: ’to sit’
ἱερὴν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ήν (= Attic ἱεράν)
ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
ἶφι: ἶφι — mightily, by force; adv. (instrumental -φι of ἴς)
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj.
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’
ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
